name: @storytree/property-checks
description: Property checks (story_c4838b46de87, ADR-1355 D4, ADR-1356 D3-D4): a targeted property or fuzz check written once with fast-check inside a numbered test of the contract it protects, run on fixed seeds in every pnpm test and on fresh seeds each night on main's head. fast-check is a dev dependency: only tests import this package, and it is never shipped in the app.
